season.title: Season and authority review
steps: Open official manual and updates; identify the rule or explicitly unresolved question
Separate final rules, previews, announcements and planning pages
Record conflicting deadline wording and transaction-specific evidence
acceptance: Every legality claim has an official edition/rule citation
Unknown future timings or dimensions stay unknown
Team registration/payment status is not assumed
season.deliverable: A dated decision table with claim, authority, applicability and unresolved items

java.title: Java implementation and test plan
context: Desktop test versus robot deployment scope
steps: Trace inputs, units, subsystem state, command ownership and cleanup
Build the isolated learning project at its pinned baseline
Exercise timeout, interruption, disable and invalid-input paths before tuning
acceptance: Compile/test commands and actual results are recorded
Requested output and measured output are distinguished
Historical projects are not treated as reproduced by another release
java.deliverable: A code/test change plan with source versions and failure-path assertions

mechanism-cad.title: Mechanism and CAD evidence plan
context: Load cases, motion range and manufacturing process
steps: Sketch acquisition, transfer, staging and release states
Trace source-code caller/end/default/periodic paths independently of geometry
Define CAD joints, clearances, drawing dimensions and an export/reopen check
acceptance: Unmeasured dimensions and loads are marked assumptions
A command goal does not certify mechanical stopping or guarding
Source file and asset licenses are checked before reuse
mechanism-cad.deliverable: A state table, CAD review checklist and proposed measurement sheet

vision.title: Vision and localization contract
context: Transform direction, units and field/alliance convention
Capture clock, latency, frame ordering and reset epoch
steps: Document frame transforms and timestamp origin before fusion
Record calibration evidence separately from synthetic estimator tests
acceptance: Capture time is not silently replaced by arrival time
Fixture thresholds are not recommendations for every camera
No vision accuracy claim follows solely from source review
vision.deliverable: A frame/time contract and rejection-policy test table

modes.title: Teleop and autonomous acceptance plan
context: Start pose, frame, completion and failure conditions
steps: Trace initial binding state, rising/falling edges, early finish and a new press
Separate readiness entry gates from continued feed authorization
Specify timeout, mode-transition cancellation and immediate versus next-periodic cleanup
acceptance: Every routine has bounded completion or explicit interruption behavior
Driver Station disable is distinguished from scheduler.disable
Trajectory reference limits are separate from corrected actuator commands
modes.deliverable: A mode/trigger transition matrix with expected software observations

troubleshoot.title: Device and evidence troubleshooting plan
context: Electrical, pneumatic, spring and gravity energy states
steps: Match the device-specific manual and changelog before interpreting indicators
Separate command, requested output, sensor reading and physical state
Preserve fault history; formulate one software/log hypothesis before a qualified physical procedure
acceptance: A warning indicator is not assumed to inhibit output
Component ratings do not establish season legality or every terminal specification
Battery variants/revisions and conflicting charge data stay explicit
troubleshoot.deliverable: An expected/observed evidence table with source and next verification step
